changelog_ledger_entries: Skill Kit KB maintainer -> Context canonical knowledge

discrepancies.detail: The rewrite changes commit IDs and does not preserve source commit signatures. Upstream signature verification is retained separately.
The rewritten tag refs resolve to mapped commits, but annotated tag objects and their annotations are not preserved.

The unchanged TacticSwitch source snapshot fails one of 200 tests because MANIFEST.sha256 is stale. Regenerating that derived manifest in a disposable tree makes all 200 tests pass, but the source ref remains unchanged; see verification/m11-legacy-check-results.json.
CHANGELOG.md remains a source-level consolidation ledger. Exact per-commit and per-tag identities are retained in the maps rather than duplicated into changelog prose.

The original bundles are not available in this worktree. This crosswalk relies on the retained commit/ref/tag maps and passing rewrite reports; bundle preflight evidence remains in its separate report.
